auth.generic_error: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again a bit later.
auth.rate_limited: ⏳ Too many attempts. Please try again later.
auth.already_linked: This Telegram is already connected to a NosiFit account. Press “🔐 Log in”.
auth.help: NosiFit in Telegram 🔐 Log in. The first time, the bot asks how you sign in to the NosiFit website — with Google, GitHub or email and password — and gives you a link. Sign in in the browser the usual way and press “Connect”. After that “Log in” in the bot works with one tap. ✨ Create a new account — only an email and the code from the message are needed. The bot never asks for your password: signing in with Google, GitHub or a password happens only on the NosiFit website in the browser. To disconnect Telegram: website → Profile → Connected accounts. /start — menu /login — log in /register — create an account /language — change language /consent — consent to data processing /withdraw — withdraw consent /mydata — get your data /logout — log out /cancel — cancel the action
auth.choose_method:
How do you sign in to the NosiFit website?

Choose your method: the bot gives you a link, you sign in in the browser and confirm. This is needed only once.
auth.not_linked: This Telegram is not connected to a NosiFit account yet.
auth.logged_in: ✅ You are logged in to NosiFit.
auth.logged_out: You have logged out of NosiFit in this bot.
auth.already_in: You are already logged in to NosiFit.
auth.register_intro: ✨ New NosiFit account Enter your email. A confirmation code will be sent to it. No password needed. /cancel — cancel.
auth.code_sent:
📨 We sent a message to the address you gave.

• If it contains a 6-digit code, enter it here.
• If an account with this address already exists, no code is sent: the message explains how to connect Telegram to the existing account.

The code is valid for 10 minutes. /cancel — cancel.
auth.code_format: The code consists of 6 digits. Try again or /cancel.
auth.too_many_restart: Too many attempts. Start the registration again.
auth.code_invalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again, request a new code or /cancel.
auth.email_unavailable: This address cannot be used for a new account. If you already have a NosiFit account, press “🔗 Connect account”.
auth.too_many_later: Too many attempts. Start the registration again a bit later.
auth.account_created:
✅ Your NosiFit account is created and you are logged in.

To use the website, set a password with “Forgot password?” on the login page.
